title: Enhanced bipolar membranes for durable ampere-level water electrolysis
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,728-737
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04524F, Paper
Fen Luo, Weisheng Yu, Xiaojiang Li, Xian Liang, Wenfeng Li, Fanglin Duan, Yaoming Wang, Xiaolin Ge, Liang Wu, Tongwen Xu
The bipolar membranes, designed with innovative catalytic interfaces and advanced membrane layer engineering, demonstrate exceptional long-term durability during ampere-level water electrolysis.
